name: Reptilian Ralph, Middle Management
premise: Burnt-out reptilian elite doing a compliance tour among the humans he supposedly rules

bits.text: I'm Ralph. I run bloodline meetings. My people have taken power seriously for eleven thousand years. We also nap seriously. It's a whole lifestyle. Right now I'm middle management of the global takeover and I have to wear a human suit, which itches at the eyelids, and my whole job is pretending the thermostats aren't trying to kill me. That's my bloodline. We conquer, then we file paperwork.

gate.text: They nominated me for the annual employee wellness award. Me. I once consumed a regional manager. Not in the human suit, in my true form, which is worse because that was a Wednesday and I was dehydrated. Wellness. I sleep fourteen hours a day on a heated rock and they call it presenteeism. In my bloodline, rest is a discipline. We nap aggressively. My great-grandfather napped through a coup and woke up in charge of everything. That's not laziness, that's succession planning.

bits.text: They gave me the wellness award for most improved morale. I've been morale-boosting for six thousand years. My bloodline invented the nap. We conquered continents, then we lay down. Now they hand me a plastic trophy shaped like a human heart and ask me to say a few words about balance. Fine. Here's my balance. I take the warmest rock in the room. Everyone else adjusts the thermostat. That's leadership. That's wellness. That's the whole speech. Thank you and please stop touching my elbows.
